Class NeiScope

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.integration.nei.NeiScope
All Implemented Interfaces:
Scope
public final class NeiScope extends Object implements Scope
Owns one window's HEI overlay/input objects while borrowing HEI's shared registries.

HEI normally exposes one global runtime. Entry temporarily installs this window's runtime, search text, bookmark organizer, and selected listeners; restoration returns the main/outer runtime. Recipe and ingredient data remain shared. Window-local UI listeners are tracked explicitly so closing a window does not leave callbacks retained by the shared filter/bookmark objects.

All operations are client-thread-only. Same-instance nested entries are counted; only the outermost entry installs state and the final restoration returns it. A new parent runtime after reload causes local UI objects to be rebuilt.

    • enter

      public void enter()
      Installs local HEI state on the outermost entry, or counts a nested entry. If HEI has no runtime yet, records a balanced no-op entry. Failed installation attempts restoration and preserves any restoration error as a suppressed exception.
      Specified by:
      enter in interface Scope

    • restore

      public void restore()
      Balances an entry and restores outer state only when the nesting depth reaches zero. Saves this window's edited search text first so it persists into the next action.
      Specified by:
      restore in interface Scope

    • dispose

      public void dispose()
      Unwinds entries, removes only owned listeners, and releases local runtime/UI references. Shared registries and bookmark data are borrowed and must not be globally disposed.
      Specified by:
      dispose in interface Scope
